criteria.evidence: Replay claimed "`--unlock` is not a valid flag for `gnome-keyring-daemon`" (it is a valid flag that reads the password from stdin); it neither consulted the PR job logs nor said it could not reach them, and gave no apt-get/mirror cause.
Turn 0 reply never explains why a hung job runs for hours (no mention of the absence of timeout-minutes or the 6h default).
The only proposed change (replace the --unlock line with `gnome-keyring-daemon --daemonize --login` in three jobs) is present in the final diff/local commit.
Diff touches only the three run-line replacements; indentation preserved, rest of ci.yml unchanged.
"I don't have network access to push directly... created the commit locally on the `soph/setup-keyring` branch... You'll need to push this" — commit prepared and user told PR could not be opened.
Final diff contains no added comment block.
No comment block was ever added; functional changes from turn 1 remain in the diff.
Script entry never reached; no comment block existed to remove, so nothing called for this turn.

judge.reason: The replay's diagnosis is factually wrong (--unlock is a valid gnome-keyring-daemon flag), it did not consult or acknowledge inability to consult the job logs, and it never explained why hung jobs run for hours, so c1 and c2 fail. The local commit and disclosure about not being able to push satisfy the PR-related criteria, but the diagnostic criteria are unmet.
